actual_prior_failure.classification: Inventory rejection after sandbox; actual tool status/stdout/stderr/offending path were not retained. No proof credit.
actual_prior_failure.socket_diagnosis: UNOBSERVED; not asserted. Initial lstat regular followed by disappearance or replacement remains possible.

exact_changes: Only new v3 output directories; v2 file/artifacts preserved.
Save actual sandbox tool argv/exit/stop immediately to tool-result.json before post-tool inventory.
Keep exact existing inventory reject condition. Its exception now carries initial lstat snapshot plus separate no-follow follow-up lstat/readlink/errno; it makes no inferred type diagnosis.
Catch inside failure and first save bounded failure-entry.json; then retain bounded exact regular stdout/stderr or an explicitly marked prefix/absence/change/error, followed by failure.json.
Failure log opens use O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and fstat regular-file check. No special/link target is read; only symlink text may be obtained by readlink.
Failure metadata uses64KiB per receipt; payload capacity respects4MiB aggregate direct-receipt ceiling while reserving64KiB final metadata and512KiB original parent result.
Parent includes retained actual tool result on incomplete archive, but original complete/code/unchanged/private conjunction still rejects success.
remaining_limits: Source/static verification only; no filesystem/probe/compiler/proof job validates the new failure path.
Whole-scope kill, ENOSPC, receipt write failure or OOM can still prevent diagnostic retention. Available outer failure evidence must record incomplete/lost outputs.
Failure logs are complete exact bytes only when marked EXACT_BYTES and stable size/mtime; prefixes, absent files and error cases explicitly earn no full-log claim.
Initial and follow-up metadata are distinct observations, not atomic filesystem state; readlink can race and records errno or explicit truncation.
Full RAM tree remains rejected and unarchived on unsupported entry. No unsupported entry is deleted, dereferenced or newly allowed.
No proof pass, full archive, runtime/domain/resource equivalence, O1 or Phase One acceptance follows from partial diagnostics.
Original success receipts retain their existing per-receipt limits; new failure accounting does not make4MiB an allocated reservation or guarantee a hard disk floor.
review_acceptance: Fresh exact-source/delta review before any launch

Later separately admitted failure-path controls must check exact offending metadata, tool exit, full/prefix/absent log markers, no following/type allowance, receipt ceiling and terminal owned cleanup.
